text: To confine our attention to terrestrial matters would be to limit the human spirit.
author: Stephen Hawking
visual_brief: An engineering schematic in fine white lines of a large radio telescope dish tilted sharply upward toward zenith. Structural space-frame trusses, elevation gimbals, and counterweights are detailed with thin dimension lines and subtle motion arrows marking the angle of elevation.
alt: Engineering schematic of a radio telescope dish tilted upward toward space
